dataModel.finding: The real Mew data model is a typed property graph in Postgres via drizzle, NOT the notes/hashtags/links shape guessed from public documentation.

tables.graph_node: pk uuid, id text, version int, author_id, created_at, updated_at, content, is_public, is_new_related_objects_public, canonical_relation_id, is_checked, slug, content_tsvector (derived), access_mode; unique(id, author_id)
tables.graph_relation: pk uuid, id, version, author_id, created_at, updated_at, from_id, to_id, relation_type_id, is_public, canonical_relation_id; unique(id, author_id)
tables.relation_type: pk uuid, id, author_id, version, label, reverse_label, is_public; unique(id, author_id)
tables.relation_lists: id uuid, author_id, node_id, relation_id, type(pinned|noteContent|all), position_int, position_frac, is_public; unique(node_id, relation_id, type)
tables.not_migrated: mew_user (identity domain), notification (ephemeral), expansion_state (UI state), data (legacy blob), canonical_path_cache (derived, latest-main only)

dataModel.hashtags: No tag table exists; hashtags are content tokens and relations in the graph. The earlier notes/links/tags Convex schema was a wrong guess and is replaced.
